pro.name: Pro
pro.desc: The best tools for professional organizers.

sports.a: We support soccer, basketball, volleyball, tennis, and any sport that uses round-robin, knockout, or league formats. You can even create custom scoring rules.

free.q: Can I use Trofi for free?
free.a: Yes! Our Starter plan is free forever for leagues with up to 8 teams. It includes all the essential tools to run a professional-feeling tournament.

share.q: How do players see the results?
share.a: Every league has a public URL that you can share. Players can also download the Trofi mobile app to get notifications and follow their favorite teams.

export.a: Absolutely. Pro and Enterprise users can export match results, standings, and player data to CSV or Excel at any time.
